summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or repo code, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs with coordinates computed by removing the padding offset; set_rnd skips keys starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NotImplementedError for missing len; numpy ceil worker split; PatchDataset example uses float; math import removed); monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter); docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset); tests/test_grid_dataset.py (new, TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array using the pinned values, plus an added test_missing_length). Caveats: tests were not run, so pinned values are unverified; set_determinism is called in setUp and again at the start of test_loading_array, as the spec asks; lines 231-233 of utils.py were already over 120 characters and were left alone; formatting was checked by line length only since black could not be run; one edit briefly targeted monai/utils/misc.py by mistake, failed with no change, and git status shows only the intended files modified.
